Extracted_Units_and_Declarations: File header (build tags, package doc, imports), functions, receiver methods, type specs, const/var groups
Embedding_and_Fallback_Behavior: Embeds breadcrumb + doc + signature; falls back to chunk.Text if file has syntax errors

Extracted_Units_and_Declarations: Functions, classes and methods, interfaces, type aliases, exported const arrow functions
Embedding_and_Fallback_Behavior: Preserves JSDoc comments and @decorators; splits oversized declarations at statement boundaries

Extracted_Units_and_Declarations: def, async def, class and methods by indentation scope
Embedding_and_Fallback_Behavior: Preserves @decorators and triple-quoted docstrings; embeds breadcrumb + docstring + signature

Extracted_Units_and_Declarations: fn, struct, enum, union, trait, and impl blocks with their associated functions
Embedding_and_Fallback_Behavior: Preserves /// doc comments and #[...] attributes; embeds breadcrumb + doc + signature

Extracted_Units_and_Declarations: Heading-structured text extracted in memory (bounded by MaxContainer and MaxText)
Embedding_and_Fallback_Behavior: Chunked by heading hierarchy; served as derived Markdown via doc.read and raw bytes via doc.read_raw

Extracted_Units_and_Declarations: Paragraph and token-budget windows across declared UTF-8 text extensions
Embedding_and_Fallback_Behavior: Configured via workspace.set_text_extensions; refused if extension collides with a registered code chunker

Extracted_Units_and_Declarations: Domain-specific declaration units defined by custom binary build (ADR 0216)
Embedding_and_Fallback_Behavior: Preserved as held (current, stale, unchecked) when opened by a community binary without that chunker
